definition: garments that can be cleaned by washing
description: A tiled terrace high above the sea. A white shirt hangs from a wooden peg on a line, moving in the wind. An older woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron lifts more white washing onto the line, pegs a white garment up with both hands, then gathers an armful of clean white clothes against her chest and looks out at the water, laughing.
